EZMB_URDA.title: Urda, Loamweaver
EZMB_URDA.epithet: The roots beneath the floor remember your passage.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_URDA.talk.firstVisit: The root remembers the first footprint. Choose where it will grow.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_URDA.talk.ANY.0-0r.a: Take only what you can keep alive. The rest becomes soil.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.description: Urda offers four root-seals. Choose one; it becomes your relic.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.ezmb_rer: Reroll these Act [blue]1[/blue] Ancient rewards once. The die appears only in Act [blue]1[/blue] and disappears after use.
NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.ezmb_reroll_i: Reroll these Act [blue]1[/blue] Ancient rewards once. The die appears only in Act [blue]1[/blue] and disappears after use.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_see:
Act [blue]1[/blue] normal card rewards can be replaced by [gold]Seedbed[/gold]: lose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] and add a [gold]Seedbed[/gold]. The first one is upgraded. Collecting [blue]4[/blue] grants [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold].
[gold]Seedbed[/gold] is a [blue]1[/blue]-cost Skill: gain [blue]8[/blue]/[blue]12[/blue] Block and set up [blue]2[/blue]/[blue]3[/blue] spaces. On play, immediately plant up to [blue]1[/blue]/[blue]2[/blue] eligible cards from draw or discard; remaining spaces catch later pollution before it enters hand.
[gold]Planting[/gold]: before a card enters hand, remove it from this combat and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Withered Husk[/gold]. It is not play, discard, or Exhaust, and it triggers none of those payoffs. Planted Temporary Status/Curses disappear after combat; permanent Curses are not permanently deleted.
A planted [gold]Blight Sprout[/gold] is handled for this combat: it does not enter hand, does not grow, and adds no [gold]Rootblight I[/gold]. A planted [gold]Rootblight[/gold] freezes this combat's end check only: no cleanse, downgrade, worsen, or split; same stage after combat.
Seedbed's value is three pieces: [blue]8[/blue]/[blue]12[/blue] Block now, fewer pollution draws, and [blue]1[/blue] Husk per plant. Each Husk later Exhausts for [blue]3[/blue] Block.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_hum: Act [blue]1[/blue] normal card rewards gain [gold]Compost Reward[/gold]: skip cards to gain [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. The [blue]3[/blue]rd compost also removes up to [blue]2[/blue] deck cards and grants [blue]1[/blue] upgraded card reward.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_mol: Remove [blue]1[/blue] Strike and [blue]1[/blue] Defend, then add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Withered Husks[/gold] as a cost. Remaining [gold]Withered Husks[/gold] are removed at the start of Act [blue]2[/blue].
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_mos: In Act [blue]1[/blue], the first room of each type entered grants a bonus: Monster +[blue]25[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; Event heal [blue]5[/blue] HP; Shop [gold]Potion[/gold]; [gold]Elite[/gold] upgrade [blue]1[/blue] random card; Rest Site +[blue]3[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold].
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_tri: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]4[/blue] cards. It is upgraded and added to your deck with [gold]Trial Branch[/gold]. You must play it in each of the next [blue]3[/blue] combats, or it will be permanently removed.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_sha: Gain [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] common relics. Defeat an Act [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Elite[/gold] to root it permanently and gain [blue]35[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. If Act [blue]2[/blue] starts first, the relic is returned and you are refunded [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_eli: After defeating an [gold]Elite[/gold], heal [blue]10[/blue] HP. Firemarked Elites also trigger this.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_roo: Urda marks a reachable Act [blue]1[/blue] combat within the first [blue]7[/blue] floors. Reaching the [gold]Root Mark[/gold] grants [blue]3[/blue] single-card rewards (first is upgraded) and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] if you have an open slot. Missing it costs [blue]8[/blue] HP and grants [blue]25[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_aft: In Act [blue]1[/blue], the first time you take unblocked enemy attack damage each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rain Breath[/gold]. At Act [blue]2[/blue] start: if triggered fewer than [blue]3[/blue] times, gain [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; otherwise heal [blue]8[/blue] HP and upgrade [blue]1[/blue] card.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_roo: Gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Root Eyes[/gold]. Click this relic on the map to select and preview a future reachable Monster, Unknown, or Elite room. Hover the marked room to view its enemy group or event. The first preview grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] if you have an open slot.
EZMB_URDA.root_sight.hover.title: Root Eyes
EZMB_URDA.root_sight.hover.description: On the map, click this relic to preview a future reachable Monster, Unknown, or Elite room. Hover the marked room to see the result. Rest Sites, Shops, Treasure, and Boss rooms cannot be chosen.
EZMB_URDA.root_sight.selection_hover.des: Click to reveal this room's enemy group or event.
EZMB_URDA.root_sight.map_hover.title: Root Eyes Preview
EZMB_URDA.root_sight.map_hover.preview_d: Root Eyes previewed this result. Enter this room to face it.
EZMB_URDA.root_sight.map_hover.event_pre: Root Eyes previewed this event. Main options: {Options}
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_see: Allows you to [gold]Store Seed[/gold] during Act [blue]1[/blue] card rewards to save up to [blue]3[/blue] cards. Click this relic later to add up to [blue]2[/blue] of those stored cards to your deck; the first is upgraded. This consumes the relic.
Choose [blue]1[/blue] offered card to store as a [gold]Seed[/gold].
Choose up to [blue]2[/blue] stored [gold]Seeds[/gold] to add to your deck.
EZMB_URDA.pages.DONE.description: Urda's blessing sinks into the soil. The chosen path is set.
EZMB_URDA.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.ancien: The root remembers the first footprint. Choose where it will grow.
EZMB_URDA.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Take only what you can keep alive. The rest becomes soil.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.title: Morvi, the Lender-Scribe
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.epithet: Every favor arrives with a margin note.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.firstVisi: Ink is a patient creditor. Borrow carefully.
Every margin has room for another debt.
You know the weight of a bargain. Sign only what you can survive.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.SILENT.0-: A quiet signature still binds. Read the margin.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.DEFECT.0-: Even a perfect machine can owe interest. Choose the useful error.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.NECROBIND: Revenge is expensive. I can advance the cost.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.REGENT.0-: A crown is a promise to pay later. Your terms await.
EZMB_MORVI.title: Morvi, the Lender-Scribe
EZMB_MORVI.epithet: Every favor arrives with a margin note.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.description: Morvi offers three signed debts. Choose one; it becomes your relic.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.ezmb_re: Reroll these Act [blue]1[/blue] Ancient rewards once. The die appears only in Act [blue]1[/blue] and disappears after use.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_f: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] upgraded [gold]Ancient[/gold] cards and add it to your deck. Playing it costs life: [gold]Attack[/gold]/[gold]Skill[/gold] cards cost [blue]1[/blue] HP, [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]8[/blue] HP. After the Act [blue]2[/blue] boss, pay [blue]180[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to keep it, or it will be removed.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_m: Once each turn, the first manually played deck [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] card plays [blue]1[/blue] extra time. If its printed cost is [blue]1[/blue] or more [gold]Energy[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] card. [gold]Power[/gold], Status, Curse, autoplay, and generated cards do not trigger.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_r: Each turn, add a temporary [gold]Overdraft[/gold] if hand space allows. Once per turn at [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], play it to draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and record [blue]1[/blue] [gold]red-ink debt[/gold]. Each debt costs [blue]12[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] after combat (or [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP if unpaid).
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_o: At combat start, add [blue]3[/blue] random temporary [gold]Archive Pages[/gold] to hand. Pages cost [blue]0[/blue] and are removed after combat.

On turn [blue]1[/blue], draw [blue]5[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold]. Extra-drawn cards left in hand at turn end are sealed in the [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], then return on turn [blue]3[/blue] as [blue]0[/blue]-cost cards if hand space allows.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_p: At combat start, shuffle [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Waste Paper[/gold] Status cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Each turn, the first [blue]2[/blue] Status cards drawn from the [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] are consumed; each draws [blue]1[/blue] and grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_b: At combat start, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Proofread[/gold]. Your first [blue]3[/blue] manually played deck cards get a one-play benefit: unupgraded cards temporarily upgrade and draw [blue]1[/blue]; upgraded cards cost [blue]1[/blue] less [gold]Energy[/gold] and gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_d: Gain [blue]220[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], remove up to [blue]2[/blue] cards, and upgrade up to [blue]2[/blue] cards. Take [blue]320[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]. After each combat, repay [blue]40[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; for each [blue]10[/blue] short, lose [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP. [gold]Debt[/gold] drops by [blue]40[/blue] either way.
Remove up to [blue]2[/blue] cards for [gold]Debt Settlement[/gold].
Upgrade up to [blue]2[/blue] cards for [gold]Debt Settlement[/gold].
EZMB_MORVI.pages.DONE.description: Morvi closes the ledger. The debt is written.
EZMB_MORVI.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.ancie: Ink is a patient creditor. Borrow carefully.
EZMB_MORVI.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Every margin has room for another debt.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.title: Lotha, the Judge
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.epithet: Every strike is evidence. Every turn receives a sentence.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.firstVisi: The court opens. Choose the law your climb must obey.
Speak once. Strike cleanly. Leave proof where all can see.
Rage may testify, but it will not be excused.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.SILENT.0-: Silence is admissible. So is the knife.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.DEFECT.0-: Metal records impact honestly. Let the record stand.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.NECROBIND: The dead may speak through you. I will hear the evidence.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.REGENT.0-: A ruler enters court as one voice among many.
EZMB_LOTHA.title: Lotha, the Judge
EZMB_LOTHA.epithet: Every strike is evidence. Every turn receives a sentence.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.description: Lotha offers three rulings. Choose one; it becomes your relic.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.ezmb_re: Reroll these Act [blue]1[/blue] Ancient rewards once. The die appears only in Act [blue]1[/blue] and disappears after use.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_m: Choose [blue]1[/blue] mirror card from your deck. At combat start, move it to your hand after drawing. The first time played: [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue].

At turn end, remember the last card type played. Next turn, your first card of that type makes [gold]Attack[/gold] and [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_p: Start combat with [gold]Innocent[/gold]. At your turn start, if you are [gold]Innocent[/gold], draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. Taking unblocked enemy [gold]Attack[/gold] damage removes [gold]Innocent[/gold], you lose [blue]8[/blue] HP immediately, and you cannot regain [gold]Innocent[/gold] for the rest of combat.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_c: Post-combat card rewards no longer appear. On Turn [blue]1[/blue]: draw [blue]4[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold]. On Turn [blue]4[/blue]: draw [blue]2[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_d: At the start of Turn [blue]4[/blue], draw [blue]4[/blue] cards, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]. Thereafter, each non-Status card spends [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]: [gold]Attack[/gold]/[gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue] card. If combat ends before Turn [blue]4[/blue], heal [blue]4[/blue] HP.

Once per run, prevent death from a fatal hit and set HP to [blue]1[/blue]. Take one final turn: draw [blue]10[/blue] cards, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and all cards cost [blue]0[/blue]. You cannot die during this turn; if any enemies remain, die; otherwise, continue the run.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_s: Each turn, your first [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] plays [blue]2[/blue] extra times. Afterwards, you may only play up to [blue]4[/blue] more cards this turn. [gold]Power[/gold] cards do not count towards this limit, cost [blue]0[/blue], and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_p: Your non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] stacks apply twice and grant [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. Enemy non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] stacks on you also apply twice; stacks applied to you are also doubled, but remove [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. At turn start, spend up to [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]: each spent stack draws [blue]1[/blue] and gives [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.DONE.description: Lotha strikes the bench. The ruling follows you.
EZMB_LOTHA.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.ancie: The court opens. Choose the law your climb must obey.
EZMB_LOTHA.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Speak once. Strike cleanly. Leave proof where all can see.
VAKUU.pages.INITIAL.options.ezmb_vakuu_f: Fight Vakuu in a greed trial. Break [blue]1[/blue] or more [gold]Stolen Locks[/gold] to cash out loot Gold and extra blessing choices. On turns [blue]1[/blue], [blue]3[/blue], and [blue]5[/blue], choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Contracts[/gold] to help break locks at the cost of increasing [gold]Blood Debt[/gold]. You may cash out after breaking any lock. No normal combat rewards. Death ends the run.
EZMB_VAKUU_FIGHT.pages.VICTORY_ONE.descr: Vakuu yields. Choose [blue]1[/blue] Act [blue]3[/blue] Ancient blessing.
EZMB_VAKUU_FIGHT.pages.VICTORY_TWO.descr: Vakuu yields. Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] Act [blue]3[/blue] Ancient blessings.
EZMB_VAKUU_FIGHT.pages.VICTORY.descripti: Vakuu yields. Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] Act [blue]3[/blue] Ancient blessings.
Vakuu yields. No other Act [blue]3[/blue] Ancient blessing remains. Broken-lock Gold is still yours.
EZMB_VAKUU_FIGHT.pages.DONE.description: The trial ends. The chosen blessing is yours.
